t: NixOS "Soul Transfer": Headless Home Server with SSH
s: This article details transforming a retired laptop into a headless NixOS home server, emphasizing declarative system management via Nix configurations for secure SSH access and eventual web hosting, achieving 'Headless Sovereignty'.
sub: NixOS installation and configuration for a headless server
Secure remote access via SSH, disabling password authentication
Declarative system management using Nix `configuration.nix` and `flake.nix`
Network segmentation (DMZ) and firewall configuration for security
